
ADD-RULE
Add a business rule to a work unit during Example Mapping

WHEN TO USE
  Use during specifying phase when capturing business rules discovered through Example Mapping conversations.

USAGE
  fspec add-rule <workUnitId> <rule>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <rule> (required)
    Business rule description

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Add business rule
  $ fspec add-rule AUTH-001 "Email must be valid format"
  ✓ Rule added successfully

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-question
  fspec add-example
  fspec generate-scenarios
  fspec remove-rule
